scoring_justification: The bond model Δχ curves are compared to a linear reference derived from the paper’s Fig. 4; element selectivity and monotonic trend are sufficient to verify reproduction without a full recompute of the structure.

hidden_assets.purpose: Expected pattern of affected tensor elements and linear trend for each distortion type
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from Fig. 4 and the text of the paper describing selective effect of A_g modes on SHG tensor elements.
hidden_assets.generation_method: For each mode the set of affected tensor elements is taken from the paper’s assignments; the reference Δχ is modelled as linear with δ (slope = 1) for affected elements and zero for unaffected ones.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Pattern directly matches the paper’s reported selectivity and qualitative shape; no synthetic holdout labels are invented.

outputs.description: Relative changes of the eight independent SHG susceptibility tensor elements under distortions along the four A_g normal modes, used to verify element selectivity and quantitative agreement with the expected linear trend from the paper.

output_contract.notes: The checker verifies that only the expected tensor elements change for each mode (selectivity) and that the non-zero Δχ(δ) curves have correlation ≥ 0.9 with a linear reference derived from the paper’s trends.
